episodes.synopsis: Aito, a lowly manga artist, continually says and does things that make his assistant, Sahoto, uncomfortable in every way imaginable.
episodes.title: Perfecting Breasts! \ Dream Job \ Panty Wars \ Mihari Otosuna's Day Off

episodes.synopsis: A new girl shows up to assist Yuuki, but there may be a problem with her. Later, Yuuki's editor tries to persuade him to alter his manga to rise in the rankings.
episodes.title: A New Assistant Arrives \ That's Important \ First Time Together

episodes.synopsis: Yuuki's porno stash is found and the models look awfully similar to Sahoto. Later, after Yuuki's hamfisted attemps to take care of Sahoto, a cute temporary assistant is hired.
episodes.title: Porno Mag Panic \ Can I Take Care of Her? \ Dark Comet Appears!

episodes.synopsis: Yuuki angers Sena who takes her vengeance upon him, the group creates a new mascot that Sahoto falls in love with, and Mihari recounts the first time she met Yuuki.
episodes.title: S & M \ Mascot Character \ Seventeen Mihari

episodes.synopsis: Yuuki meets an unusual fan in the park, Sahoto dreams of being a professional, and our favorite mangaka uses his friends as drawing references.
episodes.title: Park Shock \ Someday \ Using Close Friends for Reference

episodes.synopsis: Yuuki decides to spend his royalty check on the girls, inviting them to a relaxing vacation to the hot springs. But as it always is with Yuuki, he has ulterior motives.
episodes.title: Let's Go to a Hot Spring

episodes.synopsis: Sahoto's little sister visits, Yuuki's editor decides to spend the night, and the littlest super assistant lets Yuuki into her circle of trust.
episodes.title: Little Sister Attacks! \ A Night Together \ Piggybacking the Super Assistant

episodes.synopsis: The chief editor comes to check progress, Yuuki's dream of becoming the little girl (almost) comes true, and Mihari threatens to reassign Yuuki to another editor.
episodes.title: Chief Editor's Check \ In the Mind of a Girl \ Going Too Far

episodes.synopsis: Hindsight is always 20/20! Mihari contemplates the small mistakes that she may have made in her youth.
episodes.title: Mistakes of the Past

episodes.synopsis: Girls in bunny suits, long walks in the rain, and elevator problems are all in a day's work for Yuuki and his lovely assistants!
episodes.title: Sena-chan's Crisis \ I'll Cheer You On! \ Rain Talk

episodes.synopsis: Mihari's altered appearance is incredibly distressing to Yuuki. Cat sitting becomes a bit of an adventure for Sena and Yuuki.
episodes.title: Dreaded Change \ Do your best, Sena-chan! \ Know Yourself

episodes.synopsis: Sahoto hopes to make her debut with a new author award. The end of the summer has the group analyzing their true nature through particular clothing choices.
episodes.title: Progress \ End of Summer \ Panty Personality Test
